title: Ginger-Garlic Paste Cubes
equip: Mixie (large jar), 15ml-cell silicone tray with lid

items.n: ginger, scrubbed and sliced 1 cm thick (peel with a spoon)

items.sub: peeled garlic from Sheng Siong or Mustafa

steps.x: Scrape the ginger skin off with a spoon. Slice the ginger 1 cm thick so it doesn't jam the jar. Peel the garlic.

For each batch put 100 g ginger, 100 g garlic, 30 ml oil and 1/2 tsp salt in the mixie jar. Run in 15-second bursts for 60 sec total, scraping down 2-3 times, until a smooth paste. Don't add water, as it makes ice crystals.
Combine both batches and stir. Spoon into the 15 ml cells and level the tops.
Freeze for 3 h until solid. Pop out, double-bag, press out the air and label with name and date.

notes: Use 2 cubes (30 g) for 4-5 portions. Add from frozen to hot oil and stir for 1 min until the raw smell is gone, without browning.
Safety: garlic in oil must stay frozen or refrigerated. Never leave the paste out at room temperature.
No chilli in the cubes. Add chilli to the dish itself.
Freezer life: 3 months. After that the flavour fades.
source: None (original; inspired by LifeByMikeG's 5 Flavor Cubes doc)
